description: Hand-labelled retrieval set over the demo course in sample_data/. A hit means a retrieved chunk comes from one of the listed locations (file + page/slide, or file + Markdown section). 'paraphrase' questions are phrased the way a student might ask, without the key term from the material; 'unanswerable' questions are not covered by the material and should be flagged low-confidence.
